block.name: RX Time Recorder CC
block.doc:
This block records decimated RX power and USRP "rx_time" into a single binary file.
- Input: complex stream (typically from an UHD USRP Source). - The block looks for the "rx_time" tag to build an absolute time axis. - It keeps one sample every "decim" input samples. - For each kept sample it writes:
[double t_rx][float power]
where: * t_rx is the absolute RX time in seconds. * power = |x|^2.
The output file (default "power_rx1") can be read in Python with a structured dtype, for example:
import numpy as np dt = np.dtype([('t', np.float64), ('p', np.float32)]) data = np.fromfile('power_rx1', dtype=dt) t_all = data['t'] power = data['p']
